answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 61254 Country: India Title: Sunnah: Moving to new house Question: I want to know that what is the best practice according to the holy Quran and Sunnah for moving to the newly constructed house. Kindly send with the references. Answer ID: 61254 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1460/1484/L=01/1437) After shifting into a new house one should offer some nafl salah and then make supplication. Or some pious person is called for the supplication for prosperity and blessing. If you prepare some food and feed people to thank Allah without following any ritual and custom then it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
